subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths, or should the ADC dependency/auth-stack path be split before closing the sanitizer slice?
rationale: The issue combines a narrow stream-wrapper repair with a dependency/auth-provider decision, and automation should not choose whether to patch dependency transport behavior, alter provider auth handling, or split the tracker.

options.title: Keep one canonical tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until both the sanitizer slice and native Vertex ADC path have live proof or explicit maintainer proof override.

options.title: Split ADC auth-stack work
options.body: Land or close the sanitizer path separately and move the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure into a new canonical issue.

options.title: Accept source proof for sanitizer only
options.body: Allow the sanitizer PR to proceed on focused source tests, while preserving the ADC reproduction as separate tracked work before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until both the sanitizer slice and native Vertex ADC path have live proof or explicit maintainer proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses dependency policy, SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, and canonical issue split/close triage.
